Works inside both [[Smuggler's Rest]] and [[Crystal Cove]], as well as other quests and wilderness areas. Inside [[Smuggler's Rest]], killing a pirate will often garner 2-3 drops, and [[Treasure Compass|Compasses]] seem to drop with a higher frequency ([[Treasure Compass|Compasses]] do NOT drop in the Cove or outside Smuggler's Rest). [[Kobold Assault]] and [[Walk the Butcher's Path]] are popular quests in which to farm [[doubloons]], though any quest with a high number of [[Humanoid|humanoid]] enemies will work nicely. However, killing the [[drow race|drow]] respawns in the quest [[In the Belly of the Beast]] is likely the most efficient place to farm [[doubloons]]. Note that [[Treasure of Crystal Cove/Collectables#Treasure Map Piece|Map Pieces]] no longer drop.
